note: BUG#136 (QualityControl ledger, hecks_qa sweep SW-roster-1789347275, found live while verifying BUG#135's own fix) — Roster::Roster.Member.Retire called with id: {aggregate: "alpha", entities: ["x", "y"]}, a route-shaped value offered for Member.Retire's own declared identity-echo attribute (`id`, optional: true, not a routing source — its type MemberId declares only `value`). Ruby refuses UnknownArgument ("MemberId does not declare aggregate, entities — it takes value", normalize_args's own declared-attribute VO coercion via Value::Coercion#check_unknown_fields, BUG#41's fix); pre-fix Rust refused NotFound instead (BUG#135's own entity_element_no_identity wrap on extract_id's failure — TypeMismatch before that fix). Root cause: Rust's route-less entity_arms/nested_entity_arms None branches resolved parent/element identity via extract_id BEFORE the command's own Args::from_json (where the unknown-key check lives) ever ran, so a malformed identity-echo value always short-circuited via extract_id's own failure first, never reaching its own VO-level unknown-key check — Ruby's EntityDispatchOrder runs normalize_args (VO coercion) strictly before hydrate_parent/locate_element (identity resolution) for every entity command. BUG#38's own first attempt at exactly this reordering was reverted because it surfaced BUG#41 (a single-attribute value object's own from_json didn't check for an unknown key) as a new divergence at the time; BUG#41 is now fixed (PR #623), so the reordering is safe. Fixed by splicing a full, discarded `#{args_struct}::from_json(facts_json)?` precheck (the same `#{args_struct}::from_json` call the real `args` binding already makes, run early purely for its `?` early-error-propagation side effect — the same 'deliberately redundant, never diverging' shape BUG#54's own collision_fallback and the aggregate arm's own R3 splice already established) ahead of both extract_id calls, in the route-less None arm only, for entity_arms and nested_entity_arms alike, in both codegen sources (rust/project/registry.rb, rust/codegen/src/registry.rs) plus every already-generated in-repo domain regenerated via the full CI regen sequence.
